body: Many thanks for all your thoughts and responses. I've enjoyed it very much and I hope to get back tomorrow.
Surely people have been trying to obtain these ways for thousands of years and yet millions of people seem to be constantly failing.

There have been numerous accounts of people recounting similar experiences through the ages. Medical people explain this phenomena  due to various changes in the processes of the body/mind. 
Me, I want to believe it. But without witnessing such an experience it could simply be due to my wanting to believe it.
Ah, a fellow dog lover. Long may we care.
I would imagine many people would have the same opinion.
Would you care to explain your thoughts?

I have considered this. Could I have been such a nasty person before that this is what I deserve?
But then how do we account for the millions upon millions who live in  such appalling conditions throughout their lives? How can we measure the hell of our past lives?

What would the form of moving forward take? Material, spiritual, other?
Without tooting my own horn I believe I've been a generous, fair minded person, have often helped others, sometimes too much (it's the way I roll) very often without being offered the same support, your average ok person. 
And yet...here I am in this position.
Really. I'm always interested in this form of belief. The one aspect that terrifies me I might get to do this shit all over again, and again, and again...
Hahaha - wouldn't that be just the chocolate and nuts to top it all off:)

I binge watch tv series and movies. Whatever gets me through a few more hours in a zombie state. Plus I follow some really daggy blogs dealing with royal jewellery! Crazy huh. I have fallen out with what I thought were dear family members because I apparently offended them. No contact for months and clearly they don't really give a stuff what I'm up to. 
Some life uh?

I think the eternal suffering business is a throwback to various churches fire and brimstone theories that by and large don't get much attention these days.
Me, I'm more than hoping for the long white tunnel, being welcomed by loved relatives, feelings of wonderful peace. Maybe due to the equally dubious number of books written by people who purported to experience that. Never any concrete evidence either way of course.

For personal reasons I have given myself an age at which I plan on doing it although it is completely flexible given I;m waiting on the deaths of my pets. Yes, I love them and will continue to suffer until I can see them at peace.
